notes: Encoded ONLY from I-verter's own page. Year and week are text-verified; the month is a 6th-character letter decoded only via a chart image, so month is HELD (image-pass item), not guessed, and this style ships year + week. The page lists ECR sister/similar brands, but sharing of this serial system is not stated, so no sister is claimed and no usesStylesOf is set (same treatment as the Airco file). The ECR Brands quick-reference guide image on the page is not encoded. No era dates are documented on the page, so the default yearFloor 1960 applies.

styles.era: 14-character serials including dashes (10 normalized), year + week, month chart-only
styles.notes: Counting: page states year from the '3rd-4th character numerical digits'. Character-position counting on the normalized serial would give '9C' (invalid), so the numerical-digit reading is the coherent one: numerical digits in order are 1,9,9,9,3,0,5,1,0, and the 3rd & 4th numerical digits are '99' at normalized split positions [[2,3],[4,5]] -> 1999. Week = last two numerical digits = '10' (normalized positions [8,10]) -> week 10. Month = 6th character letter ('C' in the example), decoded only via the chart image Style-1_EMI-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png, so month is null here. Page example 1-99-C-9305-10 normalizes to 199C930510.
